question: Which symbol did the Tamil Nadu government use instead of '₹' in its 2025-26 state budget logo?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ரூ.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Tamil Nadu government replaced the Indian rupee symbol '₹' with the Tamil letter 'ரூ' in its state budget logo.**
 
• **The change was revealed ahead of CM M K Stalin’s presentation of the Tamil Nadu Budget for FY26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The official INR symbol '₹' is derived from the Devanagari letter 'र' and the Roman letter 'R'.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu’s budget logo for 2025-26 featured 'ரூ' (Ru) instead of '₹'.**
 
• **This move aligns with Tamil Nadu’s stance on promoting regional languages.**
 
• **CM M K Stalin has been vocal about resisting Hindi imposition in Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Background on India's Rupee Symbol__

 __
 
• The official Indian rupee symbol (₹) was introduced in 2010.
 
• It combines elements from Devanagari script (र) and the Roman alphabet (R).
 
• The symbol was designed by Udaya Kumar, an IIT Guwahati professor.
 
 
 
• Tamil Nadu’s Language Policy__
 __
 
• Tamil Nadu has opposed the central government's push for Hindi in official documentation.
 
• The state follows a two-language policy (Tamil and English) instead of the three-language policy.
 
 
 
• Political Context__
 
 
• CM Stalin has criticized the National Education Policy (NEP), calling it a “saffronized policy.”
 
• DMK has historically opposed Hindi imposition and supported Tamil linguistic identity.
